decisions.statement: A mark is held against the terminal rather than against the terminal's name.
A mark says the value the renamer last applied rather than the value the terminal now shows.
A terminal holding no mark is a terminal the renamer has not named.
A name and a color are marked apart.
A terminal with no process id is given one fixed name.
The fixed name is compared only inside the terminal renamer.
Nothing here renames or recolors a terminal.
Nothing here drops the mark of a closed terminal.

definition: what the renamer last put on each terminal, and the name it puts on one with no process id
